name: byte-page-fragments-consolidated
reason: Raw byte windows split one semantic row into per-page fragments with ':sequence-page:' suffixed ids and clamped source ranges; the canonical projection emits the single logical row instead.

name: seam-rows-restored
reason: Rows that fell between raw window cuts (user seeds, assistant replies, provisioning/warning/provider-unhandled ops, error rows, delegation shells) are emitted again; the recombination gate proves every page walk now equals the unpaginated projection.

name: bisected-items-consolidated
reason: An item straddling a window cut rendered twice with conflicting status (completed on one page, interrupted on another) or as a root-level fragment; it now renders once, nested in its turn, with its full source range.

name: turn-fragments-resegmented
reason: Completed turns split across byte pages rendered one summary row per page; the canonical projection renders the turn's true summary segmentation.

name: turn-bounds-whole
reason: Turn summary rows now carry whole-turn source bounds and counts instead of window-clamped ones.

name: context-shells-rendered-truthfully
reason: A parent tool call dragged into a byte window as closure context rendered as an empty delegation shell; the canonical projection renders the call as it actually is (e.g. an agent-resume tool call with its result).

name: items-carry-final-state
reason: Items whose completion fell past a window cut rendered pending/interrupted with truncated bounds; the canonical projection carries their final status, output, and full source range.

name: page-shape-timelinePage
reason: Pages are slices of one canonical projection: page boundaries, counts, and which page index carries head-state fields all change with the pagination model. Row content equality across the full walk is enforced by the page-recombination gate.
